November 23rd. Opened. Treated three patients. 
November 24th. Opened yesterday, so not opening today. 
...... 

The record book of the Evercare Clinic was full of entries like these. Unfated Tian felt no shame about it. In fact, he took pride in the habit. He even claimed to have over a dozen volumes just like it. In earlier years, the excuses had been things like: "Doudou is sick," "Yaoyao is sick," "Doudou is crying"...

"What a shame!" Unfated Tian sighed dramatically, slouching sideways in his chair. It's such a shame those two disciples are all grown up now. As their master, he had no choice but to come up with new excuses.
